# `<sl-header-item>` — Header Item

> **Only in Saipem DS.** This component does not exist in upstream Shoelace or Web Awesome: use only the API below.

Header items are the entries in a [header's](header.md) main navigation. Add a `menu` slot to turn an item into a dropdown with additional menu items.

**Status:** experimental · **Since:** 2.20

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/header-item/header-item.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-dropdown>`, `<sl-icon>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | — | `string \| undefined` | — | The URL to direct the user to. Ignored when the item has a `menu` slot. |
| `target` | — | `_blank`, `_parent`, `_self`, `_top` | — | Tells the browser where to open the link. Only used when `href` is set. |
| `current` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Marks this as the item for the current page. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The item's label. |
| `menu` | Additional menu items, usually `<sl-menu>` with `<sl-menu-item>` children. When set, the item renders as a dropdown trigger instead of a link. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper, an `<a>` or a `<button>` when it has a menu. |
| `label` | The item's label. |
| `chevron` | The chevron icon shown when the item has a menu. |

## Documentation and examples

Used inside [`sl-header`](header.md) to build the main navigation. Set `href` for a plain link, `current` to
mark the active page, or add a `menu` slot to turn the item into a dropdown.

```html
<sl-header>
  <span slot="logo"></span>

  <sl-header-item>
    Project Data
    <sl-menu slot="menu">
      <sl-menu-item>Documents</sl-menu-item>
      <sl-menu-item>Reports</sl-menu-item>
    </sl-menu>
  </sl-header-item>
  <sl-header-item href="#" current>Dashboard</sl-header-item>
</sl-header>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/header/header.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/header-item/header-item.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/menu/menu.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/menu-item/menu-item.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-header-item-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-header>
      <span slot="logo"></span>

      <sl-header-item>
        Project Data
        <sl-menu slot="menu">
          <sl-menu-item>Documents</sl-menu-item>
          <sl-menu-item>Reports</sl-menu-item>
        </sl-menu>
      </sl-header-item>
      <sl-header-item href="#" current>Dashboard</sl-header-item>
    </sl-header>
  `
})
export class HeaderItemExampleComponent {}
```

## Examples

### Dropdown with a submenu

Add a `menu` slot containing an [`sl-menu`](menu.md) with [`sl-menu-item`](menu-item.md) children.
The item renders a chevron and opens the menu when clicked.

```html
<sl-header>
  <span slot="logo"></span>

  <sl-header-item>
    Configuration
    <sl-menu slot="menu">
      <sl-menu-item>Users</sl-menu-item>
      <sl-menu-item>Permissions</sl-menu-item>
      <sl-menu-item>Workflow Rules</sl-menu-item>
    </sl-menu>
  </sl-header-item>
</sl-header>
```

### Current page

Set the `current` attribute to mark the item for the page the user is on.

```html
<sl-header>
  <span slot="logo"></span>
  <sl-header-item href="#" current>Dashboard</sl-header-item>
  <sl-header-item href="#">Reports</sl-header-item>
</sl-header>
```
